Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_10824_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_10824_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_10824 (
    input serial_in,
    output reg [7:0] data_out,
    input read_buffer,
    input reset_buffer,
    input en_16_x_baud,
    output reg buffer_data_present,
    output reg buffer_full,
    output reg buffer_half_full,
    input clk
);

// Internal signals
reg [7:0] uart_data_out;
reg fifo_write;

// UART Receiver Logic
reg [3:0] bit_count;
reg [7:0] shift_reg;
reg [15:0] baud_count;
reg receiving;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (en_16_x_baud) begin
        if (receiving) begin
            if (baud_count == 16'hFFFF) begin
                baud_count <= 0;
                shift_reg <= {serial_in, shift_reg[7:1]};
                bit_count <= bit_count + 1;

                if (bit_count == 8) begin
                    receiving <= 0;
                    uart_data_out <= shift_reg;
                    fifo_write <= 1;
                end
            end else begin
                baud_count <= baud_count + 1;
            end
        end else begin
            if (serial_in == 0) begin
                receiving <= 1;
                baud_count <= 0;
                bit_count <= 0;
                shift_reg <= 0;
            end
        end
    end
end

// FIFO Buffer Logic
reg [7:0] fifo [15:0];
reg [3:0] write_pointer;
reg [3:0] read_pointer;
reg [4:0] fifo_count;

always @(posedge clk or posedge reset_buffer) begin
    if (reset_buffer) begin
        write_pointer <= 0;
        read_pointer <= 0;
        fifo_count <= 0;
        buffer_data_present <= 0;
        buffer_full <= 0;
        buffer_half_full <= 0;
        fifo_write <= 0;
    end else begin
        if (fifo_write) begin
            fifo[write_pointer] <= uart_data_out;
            write_pointer <= write_pointer + 1;
            fifo_count <= fifo_count + 1;
            fifo_write <= 0;
        end

        if (read_buffer && fifo_count > 0) begin
            data_out <= fifo[read_pointer];
            read_pointer <= read_pointer + 1;
            fifo_count <= fifo_count - 1;
        end

        buffer_data_present <= (fifo_count > 0);
        buffer_half_full <= (fifo_count >= 8);
        buffer_full <= (fifo_count == 16);
    end
end

endmodule
